added.long_description: Ergodex is a full-stack AI-native chip design company. long_description.before:
Most cancer cases are not difficult to diagnose, only slow. A cytology sample such as pleural fluid or a fine-needle aspirate usually needs a panel of immunostains, which today means a cell block and up to two days of serial staining.

X-ZELL replaces that with Cryoimmunostaining™: direct-to-slide fixation and seven markers on one slide, read on a digital microscope, from sample to screen in under four hours. The platform (Cryofixator™, Cryostainer™, Hybrid Microscope and Cryophore™ panels) is CE-marked under the EU IVDR and in routine use at pathology laboratories in Germany.

X-ZELL is headquartered in Singapore. Its reagents are developed and manufactured in Bangkok, Thailand, under ISO 13485, next to an ISO 15189-accredited laboratory. The company was founded in 2014 by Dr Sebastian Bhakdi.

X-ZELL started with the detection of rare cells in blood. Bringing the same multiplex staining to routine cytology proved the faster route to patients, and that is where the company now focuses.
long_description.after:
The majority of cancer cases are not difficult to diagnose, only slow. Delivering the diagnosis on the same day unclogs health systems around the globe. X-ZELL's patented, CE-marked multiplex cytology platform stains seven cancer markers and a nuclear counterstain on one slide in under four hours, replacing several days of serial staining. The platform is in routine use at pathology laboratories in Germany. X-ZELL is headquartered in Singapore and its manufacturing and R&D hub is in Bangkok, Thailand. The company holds ISO 13485 medical device certification and ISO 15189 clinical laboratory accreditation.

X-ZELL started with the liquid biopsy: finding rare cells in blood and identifying them by multiplex staining. Because a liquid biopsy is cell-based, it is cytology. So the company brought the same staining into routine cytology first, where it helps patients today, and is building the liquid biopsy on that same platform.

long_description.before:
RiskCube enables startups to close enterprise deals with top-rated insurance. We offer everything startups need on their insurance journey—from D&O, cyber liability, E&O, and general liability to health, benefits, and life insurance.

Mission: Building insurance products & services focused on lowering the protection gap for the innovation economy on a national and global scale. 

Today, we operate an insurance brokerage focused on startups. Through the brokerage, we see firsthand where traditional insurance products fail, from AI liability and autonomous systems to defense technology and new space risks.

We are now building proprietary risk models that can price risks even when little historical claims data exists. Our approach uses stochastic simulation, then applies traditional, explainable models to make the output transparent to underwriters and regulators.

This allows us to create new insurance and reinsurance products for emerging industries much faster than traditional carriers.
long_description.after:

long_description.before:
OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source platform for delegating business-critical work to AI agents, from Salesforce updates to data analysis and engineering investigations.

Agents work across your company’s apps, prepare changes, and pause for approval when your rules require it. Your team controls what they can access and change, while credentials stay out of the agents’ reach and every call is logged.

https://www.onecli.sh
long_description.after:
OneCLI is the vault for AI agents. Sandboxed agents get the access their job needs, and never see a secret.

Agents like OpenClaw, Hermes and NanoClaw run in sandboxes such as E2B, Daytona and Docker, but they still need to reach GitHub, Jira, Slack and production APIs. Handing them raw keys is the risk. With OneCLI, keys stay in the vault and are added at the gateway on the way out, so a leaked sandbox leaks nothing.

Set a policy per agent, connect 100+ tools without handing out a token, and log every call. 
Open source and SOC 2 Type II: self-host in one container or use the cloud.

https://onecli.sh
https://onecli.sh/docs
